name: Miami investment properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Miami investment property opportunities may include long-term rentals, luxury condos, multifamily properties, vacation-rental-eligible properties, and value-add opportunities. Kelby Contreras helps investors evaluate location, rental rules, demand, ownership expenses, income potential, and exit strategy; clients should also consult appropriate tax, legal, financing, and property-management professionals.
